description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 22/12/2025 (Reference: 22/3162/F) for 'The redevelopment (together with demolition and part demolition of existing buildings) and refurbishment of the Island Site to provide co-living accommodation (Use Class Sui Generis), residential dwellings (Use Class C3(a)), community uses (Use Class E(d) and F2(b)), retail (Use Class E(a)), restaurants and cafes (Use Class E(b)) and offices (Use Class E(c)), new public realm with hard and soft landscaping, highways works, car parking, cycle parking, refuse and recycling storage, plant, external amenity space and associated works', to amend Conditions 2 (Approved Drawings and Reports), 3 (Quantum of Development), 27 (Cycle Parking), 35 (Refuse and Recycling), 39 (Energy Strategy), 58 (Fire Strategy and Fire Evacuation Lifts) and 60 (Retail/Commercial/Community Units) in order to facilitate the removal of two approved upper storeys; modified office and Class E floorspace layouts; amendments to the co-living accommodation and communal amenity provision; basement alterations, including a reduction in cycle parking and removal of certain storage areas; relocation of the bin store to ground-floor level; and associated internal, elevational and detailed design changes.
site_name: Land bounded by Wellington Street, Polytechnic Street, Calderwood Street and Thomas Street excluding Earl Of Chatham Public House, 15 Thomas Street, SE18 (The Island Site)
